field_principles.action_entropy: Shannon entropy over executed live action/coordinate choices as a bare float.
field_principles.arc_live_levelup_ready: bare bool proving Exp5547, registry reread, no-LLM metadata, and live harness preconditions allowed runtime.
field_principles.attempts: bare int count of runtime actions executed during the live attempt.
field_principles.field_principles: mapping of one-line principle annotations for each headline and gate field.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete:, honest_null:, or blocked:.
field_principles.llm_strategy_proposer_used: bare bool false proving no LLM strategy proposer or model path was invoked.
field_principles.no_model_specs_required: bare bool true because the declared no-LLM substrate has no model invocation to name.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: true only when the live-discovered trajectory passes the standard offline replay gate.
field_principles.random_seed: Exp5547-recorded deterministic seed reused for target rotation, trajectory gating, and checksum replay.
field_principles.registry_delta: bare int registry total delta; nonzero only when the accepted reproduction gate passes.
field_principles.repeated_coordinate_rate: fraction of executed coordinate actions that repeated an earlier executed coordinate.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: integer new levels banked from the live-discovered trajectory; success requires at least one.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed hash over target, seed, trajectory metrics, and banking gate to catch silent drift.
field_principles.selected_game: registry-safe game id used for the clean live attempt after Exp5547 and duplicate checks.
field_principles.selected_level: adjacent unreproduced frontier level label attempted by the live agent.
field_principles.solve_provenance: must equal live_agent_self_discovery so only the live runtime's own attempt can receive credit.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: list of focused tests covering clean schema, target rotation, trajectory metrics, checksum, and banking gate.
field_principles.trajectory_path: path to the detailed trajectory log containing actions, route evidence, suppression events, terminal state, and replay gate.

honest_verdict: honest_null: g50t L3 bounded_budget_no_target_level_reproduction; entropy=1.000; repeat_rate=0.000; registry_delta=0

strategy_portfolio_used.name: salience_first
strategy_portfolio_used.principle: try visually salient live candidates first without spending the whole budget on one coordinate.

strategy_portfolio_used.name: action_effect_memory
strategy_portfolio_used.principle: prefer candidates with observed or cached action-effect evidence.

strategy_portfolio_used.name: verifier_router_candidate_ranking
strategy_portfolio_used.principle: rank compatible candidates by verifier-style confidence with stable fallback order.

strategy_portfolio_used.name: conservative_reset_reinduction
strategy_portfolio_used.principle: reserve a small budget for reset or reinduction-safe candidates after local evidence stalls.
